2791.title: Thread spawn output with a multi-line prompt
2791.rootCauseOneLine: Trusted main always writes two ID lines after a successful non-JSON spawn; the empty output observation has no verified cause on this commit.
2791.proposedFix: Do not change trusted main without a failing test. Collect the installed version, executable path, exit code, and separate stream captures from an affected installation.
2791.caveats: The test uses the real CLI command and output path with a stubbed successful SDK response. No live provider was required because prompt content does not control the output branch.
